text: I absolutely used to love playing this game, but the ad pop ups as soon as you open the game is an absolute nightmare !! I think we should be giving the choice to open these up if we wanna buy any in game stuff, and recently the app has started freezing with no way to return, so then we have to come out the game, to go through the ad pop ups again, plus lose what we have gotten while the game froze !! It's becoming an issue .. It needs to be fixed or I'll be uninstalling

So bad they have to pay beta testers. And that should tell you everything about this rubbish. As is becoming typical, the demo is complete false advertising, from a company that knows no-one would download the game they actually made. It's so BORING! You just hold the button to make a bridge the right length, over and over, with a couple of luck based minigames that are mostly pointless. You just make money to build meaningless buildings, and get energy to make money..........ad nauseum.

Worlds most boring game. Buggy, laggy, loads of ads and you need a really good wifi connection or it just hangs. today i counted 22 taps to close the nagging purchase windows before i could actually get to play, by which time the discounted timer on builds had expired so that's more than 5 mins. Some tasks which you collect items for can ONLY be completed by making a purchase. AVOID unless you don't mind your brain being turned to mush... only did it for Testerup but gave up at 93

Predatory "game" that shoves micro transactions in your face every chance it gets. All of the events make you collect a type of currency for in game rewards, but locks 95% of those rewards behind a payment and reduces the rewards you get from normally playing the game by giving you the event currency that you can't use unless you spend money. Very bland gameplay ideas clearly ripped from other games and maximised for profit. EVERY TIME you run out of energy you have to click off of 5 "offers".

I like the concept of spending your energy quicker but when it runs out, why do I need to have 6+ purchase pop-ups every time? It's extremely annoying and makes it look like you're begging for money. Just not needed! For some reason once you hit the last part of anything, such as the Pinata event, it just doesn't want to give you any more bags etc even after wasting 10k+ energy. Clearly wants you to buy them even though it's a free event with the option to purchase for quicker completion.

Game lags terribly, constantly crashes, stalls between movements, have to re start all the time due to it glitching out. Lost 900 energy somehow when I wasn't playing the game. When you get it to do auto the movements sometimes stop of the character yet the timer stills goes down, how the hell does that work? I've spent money on this game so that makes it more annoying that it doesn't work properly.

I don't mind watching ads for extra energy or rewards, but the ads in this game are getting ridiculous. Many are the same 30-45 second ad on repeat for 3-6 minutes. The Vinted ad is by far the worst, having to listen to that girl "whoah-ohh" once is annoying enough, hearing it 6 times in a single ad is like nails down a blackboard. Even worse is it's not unusual for the exact same ad to pop up for the next five ad watches as well.

more pop ups than actual game play, literally had to close 16 Pop ups to get to Game play, SIXTEEN!!! that's ridiculous, then of course you get suckered into an ad at the end of those, the add crashes your device crashes and you have to start closing pop ups again and never actually reach the gameplay. wish I'd never wasted a penny on this. foolishly thought it would speed things along, boy was I wrong.

a great experience plagued by pop ups and ads. This game is enjoyable to play however opening up the game to 11 pop ups is so egregious and off putting that I find myself closing it half the time because I don't wanna spend 2 of the 5 minutes I had spare x'ing off pop up after pop up. the amount of pop ups and in game ads will chase people away. it actively makes me not spend money when my eyes are assaulted by 'watch now' 'buy this to progress' etc. cannot recommend until this is addressed

This is one of the most free to play friendly incremental games. it doesn't just have events to siphon money from players but also ones are entirely free and all you need to go is watch ads to benefit with some relief being fully free to unlock. Progress is fine if you don't spend. I'm not a fan of the Jackpot Sammy events though, it presents itself as a cup game but you don't get to follow their movements and it's just RNG where failing can lose you a massive prize pot unless you spend money.

Good game, easy to play and level up and quite addictive, however too many pop ups for micro transactions before you can even play the game. Have to watch adverts to gain some extra things, however sometimes the game restarts and you have to go through the pop ups again which is rather frustrating and annoying.

Abusive pricing and predatory mechanics! ​ This game is nothing but a financial trap disguised as entertainment. The in-game prices are absolutely abusive and predatory—charging over £104.99 for a single package of temporary digital resources is pure extortion. The progression mechanics are explicitly designed to create a harmful addiction and force players into spending hard-earned money just to move forward. Do not download this game unless you want a black hole in your wallet.

When I first installed this game, it gave me a lot of free energy, but then I had to buy energy to continue the levels, and as the game progressed, the free energy options became fewer and the prices increased as I bought them. It got to the point where it was too expensive and no positive points were considered for these payments.At first I enjoyed this game, but gradually my interest waned. And now I want to delete this game.

You will spend lot more time watching ads than actually playing game. To earn anything in game you need to have multiplier of 100 or more. However, those seriously limit your moves and won't last long. The game offers the opportunity to watch ads for very small amounts of energy, but you would need to save it up over a few days and do nothing but watch ads. The price of offers is generally far to expensive. £11-25 for small amount of items that won't provide much progress is extortionate.

it's one of the best of these types of games. good for killing time. however the amount they charge for energy is borderline robbery and the prices seem to vary wildly. very pay to win unfortunately. the free energy is pitiful. I've spent here and there but never seem to get much useful, so I won't be spending anymore. if the game keeps lagging and freezong like it has been which causes you to loose vast amounts of energy, I'll be deleting.

The fact that there are no actual adverts is not going to help this game being the worse experience I've ever had. There is at least a dozen pop up windows constantly prompting you to buy stuff you need for the game. every one of them is a minimum of £3+ Every time you run out of energy additional 7 pop ups come up even though you've said no to all of them a minute ago. If I wanted to buy stuff I'd buy it, being prompted at least every 30 sec is more annoying than anything I've ever experienced.

literally coin master with few tweaks, but i don't have any problem with that. the real issue is 1. every time when the power runs out u get 5 pop ups which is super annoying, (can't even play 5 mins without any disturbance) 2. The slowest animation in the world when getting different rewards or items which makes my auto mode run out of time. 3. if you're gonna copy another game just do it properly.

Waaaaaaaaaaay to many pop-ups before you get into gameplay. do you really need so many "events" running simultaneously? I counted 11 pop ups yesterday when I loaded into the game before I even took a spin. It's a fun game, would give 4 maybe even 5 stars but this spoils it every time I open the app to the point the fun has been replaced by frustration before I've even got going.

the game itself is fun, but I've very much come to dread opening this game. I downloaded it as a way to make money, but now I'm realising why they were paying people to play it. You have to sit through typically between 8 - 11 ads. You know they're gonna come up, but it takes a good minute and a half to cross them off totally because the game also takes a second to put the next ad up. Please half the amount of ads, its usually for the same items but different amounts of crystals/energy.

fun...ish. It's ok... a simple game to keep you occupied without being so involved that you cant put it down. Normally, that would be perfect for me because that's the type of game I use for personal downtime and decompression. Sadly, every time you run out of lives you don't just have the normal amount of pop ups for purchases, there is at least 5 or 6 every time. not just normal play but additional side levels too. It is so intrusive and off putting that I will likely be deleting the game.

Very annoying (and addictive) game - like Monopoly Go but not as good. It's fixed so that big rewards are always just out of reach (unless you are really lucky), and it costs more virtual money to complete levels the higher up you get, but the rewards don't increase, so it gets harder and harder to progress (without spending real money). Also far too many ads / pop-ups

Ultimately frustrating. Difficult to progress without spending money, but that in itself isn't the major problem. I don't mind the challenge, but way too many times, "bad luck" at the last minute seemed to thwart getting the final bonus when items stopped appearing. The final straw was when I got to 2100/2200 with 24 hours to go for a 4k energy bonus. Suddenly this switched to 1000/2200 for a 2.4k bonus. Possibly a bug, but honestly I've had enough. Sort of fun for a while.

the game play is fun and is paced well. There is lots to do as well but every time you log on it takes 2 mins to start because of the "you can pay this or buy this pass!" I literally got 7 pop ups before I even started. once you run out of energy it's the same like 4 or 5 pop ups to purchase this or buy more energy. I get that apps need to make money but I've never seen this many pop ups before. it's insufferable! honestly I'm deleting this game it's not enough to bother with all the pop ups.

Wish I could give 0 stars - nothing like the adds you're just holding a button down to place a bridge and running over it - and if it's too short or long you fall off and do it again. There's no strategy, no nothing it's just running and stopping and running and stopping and then being forced to attack another player which is literally just clicking the screen at their island. SO dull and so very disappointing. I assume all these 5 stars were paid to leave them! won't keep you entertained at all

Tragic... if you don't spend a lot of money, zero game. Expensive packages, the free energy is minimal, not enough to play the game. Maybe because I downloaded through Free cash so they want to get the money they give back. I spent a lot these days and yesterday I said enough is enough and so I can't go further. I will uninstall this and free cash too. Also I don't think that is a good game anyway, a lot of work without value.

the game is nice, but that's that. with every move the constant pop up ads on their own events it's very annoying and makes my game to completely freeze up. why is necessary for the same event thing that you have in within the game to pop up 100 times / 5 minutes? extremely annoying. I can remember the ongoing events and I'm able to tap on the side of the screen on the event that I want to play. you don't need to shove a pop up as and in my face every second to remind me of your event!!!!

it's full of bugs. was supposed to get 8000 moves today but it timed out and took away the moves. this was the 3rd time I was supposed to receive something in the game that it didn't give me. so frustrating because the game itself is annoying. I have to tap through 14-18 pop-ups when I first open the game. today's glitch was the last straw. I have to uninstall.

the rewards app I was playing this game through refers to the game by the name AdGate in the notifications, and how true that is. every time you load the game you have to click through around 10 popups before you can play, every time you run out of energy(which doesn't last long at all) you have to click through 6 popups. it's obnoxious. the only reason I played the game more than the first time was to get money from a rewards app. complete garbage.

it's a nice relaxing game with good features but as normal paying is really in your face right as soon as you log in the damn app. although the game does allow a good play through watching adds for free rewards this then causes it to crash most of the time and constantly rebooting it where then the annoying payment adds keep getting slapped in your face. please fix this! and it would be a better score.

Frozen and wont play. Game played great for a few days, it then froze and now wont do anything. Tried clearing cache, uninstalling and reinstalling, restarting my phone, tried combinations of all 3 and nothing. Made sure app and device software are up to date, still nothing. Have today emailed support in the hope they can/will help.

What a disappointment ! This game is purely a money making game . Now I understand I am obliged to buy things in the game . But talk about rip off ! I spent my very small game allowance today and got virtually nothing ! It just tries to gain more money . No enjoyment anymore ! The ads are absolutely terrible time wasting things , that crash all the time ! Such a shame because the game itself is fantastic ! I'm just not rich enough to play it ! Better off on Tiger Bingo ! The 3 only for game !

It takes 1-2 minutes just to play the game as you must close 20 million pop ups pretty much demanding you pay them. which gets annoying when the game buffers and I have to exit and re-open. Also the shields do not work, I have had the same 3 shields from when I started playing that never protect my money from being stolen. They only work when blocking my attacks against others. Honestly this game is pretty much just like the others of its kind, I am only playing because of Freecash.

this game is fixed. I invested time and money to get to 3700 clover to receive 6 thousand power and when I was ten short the prize changed even though there was 9 hours left of it to run. update. Since I posted this I have had the development team contact me in an effort to get me to change my review so here goes. the majority of the challenges set are rigged so that they are almost impossible to reach without paying vast amounts of money. DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME.

i liked it. i even got past the annoying intro ads. i even spent a little money playing and enjoying it. But now im pissed. it keeps freezing when i redeem certain points. it never would give me the game credit. Had to restart the game and lost everything including real money. its a NO for me. taking it off family devices as well.

Was fun, but is rigged for you to pay to play & constantly freezes. When the game freezes, you lose a lot of progress & "energy" when you go back in after closing the app. Shortly after starting this game, you will realize that to continue playing or getting past certain checkpoints, you will have to pay. And when you do pay, sometimes it still cheats you out of the stuff you earn. It's a LOT to explain & I'm limited on characters for this review. Start playing & you will see what I mean.

You'll spend more time exiting out of pop ups than you'll spend playing the actual game. And when you watch videos to get rewards there's a 50/50 chance that the video will make the game crash halfway through the video, won't reward you, and when you go back into the app it makes you go through all the pop ups that you just clicked out of. Separately, the gameplay is not great. And if someone steals your coins while playing that also will make your game crash. I'm uninstalling very soon.

This game was fun at the start. Now, it is becoming way too costly to advance. I paid too much money, completing side missions to have the energy and items needed to advance through the game. The more I advance, the more I had to pay just to complete side missions. I spend more time watching advertisements than playing the game. A special offer here and there is okay, but charging more to complete side missions is overkill. I can't afford to continue playing anymore.

This game is alright, but the amount of in app pop ups is absolutely overwhelming. There's too many different things going on within the game. When I first open the game, there's 9 pop-ups alone asking for money and then one for an ad. If you happen to click the energy when you don't have enough, you're in for about 6 more pop-ups. It's too much.

This game would be really fun if it didn't have so many dang on pop ups! It's like 50 pop ups when u first open the game, then 50 more when u have less plays than ur bid. We already know about what's new with the pop ups to where we shouldn't see it through the rest of the game. I would definitely play more if it wasn't for that. I can see myself deleting this game soon if they don't change things!!!

This game has way too many pop ups during gameplay, you have to click the x so many times before even getting to play initially it's very annoying, way too many ways that they try to get you to spend money on the game, on top of that it freezes and crashes in the middle of collecting coins and then when you close out and restart the game you lose all the coins you earned when it crashed and all of your energy too, very frustrating game.

this game might be fun if the developers played it themselves to see how annoying all the pop ups are and fixed it. just opened the game after not playing for a couple days and I had 24 pop ups before I could start playing the actual game. there was a pop up or 3 for every new event, every new thing I could buy, all the events that are over, etc. Plus when you actually play the game for every event you collect items while your rolling and you get a pop up almost every roll. Ill probably delete

This game is cute and fun but it literally took me like 10 minutes to get into the game with all the pop up stuff that happens when you open the app. And its so frustrating that when you run out of bets it restarts all the pop ups again. And there is so much stuff on the screen you barely have playing room. I'm not against them trying to make money but could we have all those pop ups maybe once every 30 minutes to an hour instead of every few minutes? Sadly uninstalling soon.

This is very Monopoly Go-ish in terms of it's a $ grab app. There are some things you can't obtain unless you buy the last part of the items you need. You can't win the big prizes unless you spend $. The algorithm used is def not set up fairly. Those stupid tickets that you try to collect, with about a day left of that event with all the packs I've obtained, I seem to can't get a 2 star ticket. I have a HUGE friend list and EVERYONE still needs this 2star ticket. How can that be??????

This game is similar to several other games and the little bridge thing was kind of fun at first but now it's just sort of annoying. At least they have the auto build the bridge button. I also wish that you could see what you were building before you tap on the icon that would be cool. Overall this game is just all right & I probably won't play it past the goals for the Tester up app.

I really like the game. What I do NOT like, however, is spending my money on a game to get more energy and then just getting one coin over and over again! It's very obvious that they have it set up to screw you if you're betting higher per bridge. Also, the baguettes or rolling pins, or whatever they are this week, are bogus. You could be getting things you can ACTUALLY use in the game, but of course they give you the thing you HAVE TO SPEND MONEY TO USE more than anything else.. Fed up...

I like this game but I still think it needs improvement. The game is supposed to be free. But there's constant side games that only you allow you to advance 5 times let's say before it asks you to spend money to go further. Sammy Cups Sucks!!!... The snake 🐍 does not randomly move. The game allows you to advance so much and then no matter what cup you choose you have to either loose everything or spend money. Same thing goes for the beaver flip coin guy.

This game takes forever to load on my new phone with fast Internet.The app is slow and clunky. When it finally loaded, I counted over 10 interrupting pop-up screens before I could even begin play! That's insane. The frustration of just trying to get to the point where play begins is enough to cause me to delete this game and never play it again. No thanks. I don't find it fun for this reason and will be deleting it. There are too many other games that are more pleasant to play.

If I wasn't making a little extra money from playing, I wouldn't touch it. It's nothing like the ads and is so insanely boring. I honestly would've un-installed it the first time I opened it and got bombarded with 15-25 pop ups for whatever overpriced bundles or bs pay-to-win events and tournaments are going on.

Can't even get the game to load so I can play it... the loading screen takes a long while, and then I get stuck on 99%, and the screen never changes, unfortunately. I thought it might be my WiFi, so I turned it off and used my data--still doesn't work. Will update if this changes, but I don't have much hope for this.

I've tried opening the game 3times now and it crashes everytime. The 1st time I denied notifications and it crashed. The 2nd time I denied notifications and it got to the character selection then crashed. 3rd time I still denied notifications and it got just past character selection and I built 2 things in the tutorial and then it crashed. I didn't get far enough to know if the ad for the game was accurate, but it looks like it probably wasn't which also creates an expectation that isn't met

I'd give more stars if my screen didn't freeze a lot when moving to a new town or whatever or after a steal or attack! Then I've gotta go through the 20 start up pop ups while my auto time is running! The game is fun, lots of free items and energy is given so it's easy to keep playing without running out but the freezing issue is getting worse and more frequent I hope to see it fixed or I'll have to just delete as it's too frustrating!

If you ever wanted to love and hate a game at the same time then this is it. It's fun,challenging and interactive but my word the number of pop ups and ads is ridiculous. You will literally get a free boost or upgrade for 5 mins and you are stuck closing pop ups for that time so it's useless. Not to mention the glitches, can be very frustrating

Downloaded this to get rewards on another game. It's interesting and easy to complete. You get a lot of freebies everyday and you can level up using just these and not spending any irl money. Good thing that you don't get any random ads during game play, but there are so many in-game pop ups about offers and bundles which take forever to close.. giving it 4 stars because sometimes the visuals are harsh/too fast and overestimating for me and the unnecessary pop ups

This game is one of the easiest and best games I've ever come across! It's fun, relaxing and very easy to play and navigate the platform. I love the game, and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing, and stress-free game. You'll definitely love Animals & Coins.... It's worth every time, and effort. 🥰❤️

Of the games of this type, this is probably the one I've enjoyed the most. It's really fun and engaging in lots of little ways which makes all the difference when deciding between the many other slots type games. I like the mini games and I like how I can still progress enough to enjoy the game while it still gets harder the further I get in the game. Glad I gave this a try!

It's easy to earn free spins, and, if you keep your wits, it's easy to keep earning. The trick is to go back & forth between 10x turns and 25x turns. I try to figure out when the next jackpot prize is up and then switch to 25x every 5 or 5 turns. Hope someone sees this and gets to play better.

The game keeps crashing while trying to watch an ad, and then it restarts. phooey. The game bombards you with constant popups asking you to buy stuff for the game. I've read reviews by others who say the same thing, and creators keep telling people they are sorry and that they are constantly trying to improve the game. they have been saying this since the earliest reviews and nothing has changed. The reason it keeps crashing is cuz of all the popups. They need to only have a few.

stole my money. I purchased a 23 dollar package and it never gave it to me. when I submitted a ticket, an automated response says I'll have to wait 3 business days. that means 5 because the weekend is coming up. very poor support. especially when money was taken. Do better! I will say once I replied to the automated email. they responded quickly. still no resolution though

I like the game itself, but it has a ridiculous amount of delays and lags constantly, which is super annoying, especially if you're using a timed power up which doesn't stop counting down even if you're waiting for the game to move you forward. literally between every single move you make there is a 5-10 second delay while you have to wait for the loading screen to go away, and then another delay before you can even begin an attack or a steal, it's just stupid, idk why I still put up with it

I like playing the game but its impossible to get enough energy to play unless you pay money to buy moves. theirs no way to win enough of anything if you do not spend money so basically this is a pay to move to next level game plus when you get up in levels to 600+ their prices gets way too high. im about to uninstall the game for this reason. most of the 5 star reviews have nothing to do with this game and believe its people that dont know about the game are leaving them.

This was my favorite game. I've been playing for about a year, little over a year. i would play 2 or 3 times a day. couldn't wait to wake up and play. But alot has changed the past 4 months. Now this game makes me wanna throw my phone across the room. Now i struggle daily with deleting it. i just keep hoping that it goes back the way it was. We work to hard in this game to have our energy taken. Mostly i get all coins but never enough to complete an island. And lately my game has been cuting off

The game starts out fun, but quickly becomes a cash grab. Progress slows to a crawl unless you constantly buy expensive packs, and events are clearly designed to pressure you into spending more. I spent hundreds of dollars and realized the goalposts just keep moving. If you're thinking about spending money, be prepared for an endless cycle of "limited-time" offers that never seem to end. Play for free or don't play at all.

great and fun game. I have 3 concerns, 1. when you open the app to play you have to go thru 7-10 screens of sales popups before you can even start the game. 2. I can't see the whole screen. I can't see the setting or whatever is on the far right top. 3. it would be great if I didn't have to go thru all those screens that pop up when you open the screen. if I didn't have close each popup when I'm my low on energy.I can see the sales on both sides on the screen. the excessive pops up. deterrent

I'm playing this thru Gravy Pass (google wallet), and I've gotten most of my rewards, right on time. which has been fantastic! my main issue is there a couple "spend" missions that have more than surpassed, but have not received the rewards for. However, the dispute button is greyed out and I feel like I have slipped through the cracks somehow... i really need the support team to reach out so we can resolve this.

This game is fun but....this game is not great on rewards. you spend 1000's of energy just to get a small reward of 120 energy or even a small amount of money. then even more energy is spent on side games just to lose it all if you can't afford to spend money on the game. It would be nice if we could get energy back for unused tokens. don't know how long I will play cause I am down to no energy and no way to get any unless I pay

This would be a 5 Star, because it /was/ a fun game, in the beginning. But having reached Island 500+, my events now barely give sufficient rewards, all my purchasable packs are $35+ per pack, and some are $35+ x2 within the same pack, and now all of a sudden my attacks and steals don't award me any trophies for the Tournaments that have been running 24/7 since starting but suddenly aren't there anymore. 👎 Greedy.

I haven't played long, but it seems like a fun, simple game. I usually hate when games bombard you with a ton of ads, even optional ones, but these ones usually have worthwhile rewards... mostly free energy, which is really nice if you don't want to wait for it. My only complaint, which isn't unique to this game, is when you get prompted with one sale pop-up after another, and it happens 3, 4, 5 times.

good game but the ads are the start are excessive and now today after all the pack and event display the game just hangs and doesn't let me click anything. I have tried clearing the cache but it still doesn't work. and building rush is just counting down on the background, wasting away. would be an easy way to claim more energy but I can't do anything, what a waste. I'm only rating this a 2 because of this. losing out on an opportunity like that to a glitch, I know when it finishes it will work.

This game was not as advertised. I was brought to this game by an interactive trailer on another game. In the interactive trailer, you had to move the character left to write, and went through barriers that could multiply or lower the amount of logs you've collected to cover gaps. I like games like that. The game actually however has using energy to build bridges and building islands, "attacking and stealing from other players"... It's not what I was expecting. Very unhappy with the deceit.

I never wanted to play this game because of the old reviews saying too many ads, plus crashing. But i have been playing for months now, it crashed once, and the ads are predictable enough that i can get past them without an issue. Lots of game variety, it changes and keeps me interested,I'm playing for free, and the only thing i found aggravating is when you're using points to go to the next level, and you have sooo many points that you should be able to skip and just go up 6 levels at once.

I understand Ads and they are necessary for free play, but every single time I try to do something, I get hit with 5 pop ups telling me to buy something or connect to Facebook, two things I dont want to do. They make the game not even worth it when there are so many other options in this genre. Edit: if my feedback is important then I shouldnt need an email to forward complaints to.

Trying this game again since another rewards app let me run it. It takes far too long to get playing. It should not take a solid 3 minutes and 14-18 pop ups to get from opening the app to playing. Not to mention all the additional pop ups throughout the game. I understand how this game makes money and keeps running, that I don't have a problem with. But that much delay just makes me want to not play.

fun addicting game. I've gotten $0.01 here and 0.17 there through the freecash app. im now at $12. I think. ill keep updating as I play and cash out at $25.... but so far it's addicting and I see payouts in small amounts going to the other app connected to it. however, the 2 negatives I have are #1, excessive ads that try and trick you to click, then open up playstore to the ads game or app, then it takes a while to finally get back in the game to play. also auto timer never stops during pauses.

I'm pretty sure they spent 20 minutes making this "game" and hours on the pay walls and pop ups. It's not even funny how bad it is and they know it. The game style is a complete rip off from monopoly go. Like most reviews I see I only play it for the rewards app, which some days isn't even worth it... I sincerely hope no one sinks money into this. Devs don't comment I won't read it. Shame on you all.

App crashes constantly. It stays functional long enough to show me 11 popups for in app purchases, then crashes when I actually try to play. I can't make any reasonable progress. it's really irritating because this would be a fun game otherwise but the constant crashing really ruins it. My device isn't the problem because this is the only game that crashes.

EDITED..It's a fun game to play. but the popups as soon as you open the game about buying more coins is excessive to say the least. I'd have given the 2 a 5 stars but when you have the option to watch an ad to double your coin and the ad takes two minutes. it would be nice if you actually got double the money like they said you'd get....EDITED...other than the glitches of the ads it is a really fun game to play. it definitely is a five star game. Just don't watch the ads and you'll be fine.

the game itself is fun. But....EVERY, SINGLE, REWARD no matter how small stops gameplay to run the effects. I'm talking the average rewards on every tile, you're a solid 10 seconds watching and waiting. which means when you do finally win an auto option, you're lucky to actually use 2 out of the 5 minutes given., the rest of the time is waiting for the reward effects. if it weren't for free cash I wouldn't have gone past the first couple levels its so annoying.

Over all a ver fun and addictive game. It is, however, very buggy. It crashes all the time which is sad because it's so fun to play. That being said, if you plan on making an in game purchase, be aware it may crash in the middle of collecting rewards as it did with me twice now. Contacted support and got a fairly quick response and was compensated after showing proof of purchase and a detailed description of the package purchased. I hope they fix the crashing problem as I love playing.

It takes minutes just to start, the 8-12 popups, then the game freezes and you have to restart it. It glitches, and you can't use energy. The cup game, literally every third cup is a snake. It has potential but needs major bug fixes. Don't expect to win the special collections (collect 10 and win) unless you're paying for it. I made it to level 150 in thirty days, but I'm so over it. This won't be one I keep.

Very samey, and the part of the game originally advertised is nowhere to be seen. All you do is build bridges over and over and over and over. The extra reward games are full of 'watch an ad' to continue, and the game gets constantly interrupted with pop up after pop up , some just info, but most trying to make you buy stuff or watch ads or connect other people to the game. Very disruptive and tedious, and the ads go on forever. No skill required, either. Waste of time. Will uninstall.

If it wasn't for the fact I'm playing to make money, I wouldn't actively play this game on its own. Great concept, but It continues to glitch and freeze up, at times when I have had millions of coins, over a thousand bolts, and I just paid for the final building on level 26, only to end up losing it all after it froze up. Maybe, if there weren't so many side quests going on, which annoyingly pop up every 5 seconds, the app might be able to function. Just food for thought.

Simplistic game, which is what I was after. However, having to click through 7-10 ads, promos, and check out our side games ads *every* *single* *time* I log in, plus having the same set of ads show up every, single, time I run out of coins is overkill. It reminds me of the pushy used car salesman. Thought I could ignore them. I was wrong. It is annoying to the point I deleted the game. Bummer.

All about money! The game is not functioning properly. I spent money on 2x points for 20 minutes, it wasn't cheap. I noticed quickly that the points were not adding properly. I tapped the bar, and it kicked in, but I lost the first 5- mins. The pinata is also buggy. The home screen often says I have 10 points more than it does when I enter in to complete. I also notice that when you get a perk for 5 minutes, the game diverts to functions that wear the clock down. Boo!!

I'm not sure how this game has been rated 4.8 stars. Just to open the game, you have to exit out of 6-9 different prompts trying to get you to purchase things, then the ads to get free stuff are a minute + each, and your "energy" takes 10 hours to fully restock. By the time I get through the prompts and to the actual game, I don't have time to play. Lastly, even when you change the settings, the sounds don't completely turn off, so you can't listen to music or podcasts without hearing the game.

Starts out fun, but don't spend money. You get to a certain reward after buying an offer, the game crashes, freezes, glitches. When restarting, you've lost coins and energy, but the completed island reverts back to incomplete, but don't get your energy or coins back. Frustrating. I don't mind spending money on a little mind-numbing game if it's fair. Customer service was helpful with comps for the first few times, but have dwindled the longer I play and glitches are more frequent. Uninstalling.

Game is great and would get 5* BUT The game keeps crashing, losing everything you've just won When you're on Auto, the timer doesn't stop on every move where you have to collect items, attack or steal. It's extremely frustrating. The time lost mounts up to quite a lot! You play to win prizes from items you've collected, but then they put a pay for item halting your steps. That's not fair!! Its spoiling the game.

Playing to earn energy. Shooting for the 1.2k or 1.6k, whichever it is, and I get to less that 100 away from earning it, and the game shuts down and reloads, but stops at 99% and won't finish loading. That event expires, the game loads fine. I get to the same point, but with 48 hours to go in the event, and it locks up, stopping at 99% loading. It might just be their design to lock people out from moving forward. Shutting the phone down/restarting does nothing to resolve the issue. UNINSTALL!!!!

Don't waste your time or money. The app keeps crashing, literally every three or four minutes. Idk why I'm still trying to play it but when it works it's fun. However, I just bought the starter pack and the app crashed in the middle of buying it. The payment was successful but I didn't receive the coins or the energy. Update: got a "we're sorry" comment, and all kinds of run around from customer support. Don't waste your time or money.

it's not even playable. They're so busy trying to sell you stuff that there's no room left over for the game. Last I was there it was an endless cycle of their ads. When I closed the one that's up now another one opens. No game. So I closed the game, or the ad platform, and came back to the play store to write this review. I somehow doubt that their description of the game sounds anything like mine.

It sounds nice in theory. The first issue appears in the pop-ups. Just for opening the app, you can get bombarded with pop-ups for different events. Then, once you finish all your energy, you get several more trying to get you to buy more energy. In terms of spending energy, you often don't get good prizes. It's usually a *small* amount of coins, or the "attack other players" feature. This I do not like because it doesn't give me much choice. None of this feels like choice, more (lack of) luck.

Frozen Issue. I was really enjoying the game until just now when I made an in app purchase and it decided to freeze. I cannot click on anything, but all the count downs are working. I guess I wasted money. I still cannot click on anything and it's been 15 minutes. I've done all the basic trouble shoot, but morning has worked. How to I get some help? I don't want to miss out on any more rewards. Thank you.

It's absolutely awful. Every action you perform triggers 4 or 5 pop up ads for itself. It takes five minutes to load, often crashes, and now the game won't even open. When I could play, it was extremely dull. To add insult to injury, the offer wall steps include things "spend $68" and "reach island 800 in 20 days." It's just ridiculous garbage; a poorly made cash grab.

I loved this game until recently. I've made it to some where around level 40. The game has suddenly stopped working. After I exit all the game's pop ups, I get a little downloading symbol with a paw print. After a couple minutes it will go away, but then nothing on the screen works. I tried restarting the game several times, but nothing works. It would have been a great game if it wasn't for this problem.

Fun but... the owl games I feel are rigged to make you select the snake. Also, why are the levels so hard to get the puzzle pieces. I don't like the extra games that you use so many of and then you have to purchase the next one so you are just winning things you can't use unless you spend your money on more energy. In each round there are more chances to win coins vs energy. Don't know if anything can or will be done just warning other players. I've spend money and lost quickly.

started out fun, I started to notice it was a very greedy game. almost all the events you had to pay to $2 to $10 to be allowed to finish to get more energy. theres patterns in curtain events. at round 150 it cost so much to upgrade you needed discounts to level which you usually had to pay for. with that many adds you shouldnt have to pay to finish the game. if you aren't willing to pay to win,this isn't the game you want to be playing. I only played for atlas earth bucks. I dont recommend

Only wants your money. The few boosters that exist usually only go 5 min, and with all the ads and time waiting for items to transfer into the ever changing events that usually lead to a pay wall, there is no time for the booster. Its gambling whether you spend money or not. The game dangles carrots in front of you for everything. The whole game is a disappointment, its not a game, there is no challenge to it, its just a fancy slot machine. I only played it to get paid by a 3rd party app.

Gameplay is simple, and I have not experienced lagging or technical problems. The ads for other games are optional and not bad. Only complaint with this game is that the in-game purchase offers are WAY too pushy, making gameplay tedious, since you have to turn down every offer individually before each round. Offers are numerous and run concurrently, so every time there are between 5 and 8 popup offers to turn down before I can get back to the interrupted game.

Lets start with the seemingly endless purchase pop-ups when you start up the game. The same purchase options lined up down the side of the screen while playing...so don't think you will just jump on the game real quick if you have a little time to burn. Nearly 40% of the ads you watch will result in no compensation. Many of the in game rewards are timed. Unfortunately the game play transitions are very slow and the timer keeps running. Too many games out there to be dealing with this one..DELETE

Not so bad, like playing the Game, just something I have noticed, when you buy pieces on the Island, there are occasions where I have more than enough Coins to buy a piece, but the thing tells you, you don't have enough Coins. Wish I could upload the Screenshot to show what I mean. I just hope they will fix it, as it has happened quite a few times already. 😔

I'm about to delete this game. It wasn't the game advertised to start with. It's a mindless time waster, which was good to begin with, but pop-ups end up driving you insane. Every time you open the game or run out of energy, you're bombarded with pop-ups. Several times, I've collected enough of the collectibles for a prize, and the prize wasn't given. I've also finished an island before, had the game freeze and when I restarted it my island was only half done and I had no coins.

Played this for a long time and never had an issue. Completed a task today, was awarded the 60,000 bonus energy, then less than 5 minutes later the game glitched and I had to restart it. Upon restarting I saw my award was gone. The company acknowledged there was a problem only to give me 500 of my 60,000 energy. That's terrible business practice.

COSTLY!!! The game cannot advance very far without spending money. The first 30 secs are numerous pop ups asking for money to buy tokens for the game. There are different little games within the game. They cost you the tokens you have bought, to play, and lose them. The game is addicting and geared to take a lot of your money. I am Deletingi the game after spending 100's of $$$$$ on it. I say stay away, it's not worth what it costs. GUARANTEED

Definitely more of a pay to play game than free. I watch as many ads as possible, which is limited to about 4/day for 10 spins. Purchasing spins is pointless because the algorithm is set to only allow you to advance very little at a time. It takes days to accumulate enough coins to get to the next level. When you start the game you're bombarded with offers then ge about 2 mins if you're lucky of playtime, then wait another day to do it again. The idea of the game is nice but unfortunately it'sno

At first I had plenty of fun just enjoying the game. However, once you start getting to higher levels: there's WAY TOO MANY pop ups for events. You'll spend a good 2-5 minutes just closing out of the pop ups. Not only that: it gets harder and harder to advance levels since the only real way to get energy without waiting a long time for it is by paying for it. If this is just another Pay To Win game: it's not going to last long at all.

So I never leave a lot of money left in my bank when I close the game and buy the most expensive lots first. Every time. Multiple times I have come back and I don't have my bed or whatever, and I have more money than I should have (but not the amount of the items purchased.) This happens too many times for a game that I put money into. Edit: wow... Just got 3 trophies and every time the game froze. Didn't care but then realized that I was supposed to get those for an instant win.

Not worth your time if you're trying to get Swagbucks through this game. Game play is simple and repetitive. You'll breeze through the first 10 levels, then it's a slow crawl to get any further. The game freezes up frequently, and everytime you open the game you have to X out of no less than 7+ ads trying to get you to spend real money on the game. In addition, you need energy to progress and they do not give you enough to make it thru what's required for Swagbucks. It's a lost cause.

The game initially was good. There's a lot of ads and promotions to purchase items which makes it a timely process to begin the game cause it goes thru all the options in the beginning. Lately it's been crashing before I even get a chance to play. It's been frustrating cause I haven't been able to play for 2 days cause of the constant crashing. Please fix it.

this game was fun, and I used a "paid to play" app to start playing. I've gotten to the levels where I start making decent money, and magically, the game won't let me play. when the app is opened, you have to x out and get through an unacceptable amount of them pushing purchases on you. annoying enough, but now I sit through the incessant, desperate sales pitches, and the app closes. 15x a day for over a week. it'll start working right after my time is up to get paid. it's infuriating.

First off I actually love playing this game, when it works correctly. My first issue is that it freezes way too much and then has to reload and the reload takes forever. Also I have made several purchases and not gotten all of what I paid for and that is a big problem. I reached out to the makers of the app and they have yet to respond or make it right. Also the perks and the competition things have time limits so when the game gives you a double points that lasts for 5 minutes it's too short.

You can't open the game and play without having to close at least 15 pop-ups for "packages" and "deals" for in-game currency. There are a bunch of regular ads for other games as well! If you accidently click the ad instead of the X in the corner, it will automatically download whatever game is in the ad to your phone! The game also glitches and doesn't give you all the energy, crystals, etc. You earn in the game and will crash randomly, making you lose progress and energy as well! Don't play it.

Game is okay but there are glitches that need to be fixed like the timer for bonuses continues to run even when the game is loading or freezing and the swarms of ads that keep popping up. If the game freezes and you restart you have to go through them all over again and your bonus is pretty much gone. The snake game is also clearly rigged the higher up you go... the odds are very low to hit him 2 times in a row yet alone 3. It's happened many times. I've pretty much given up on that game.

Big waste of time. The game itself is awesome but there are to many negative things with it. Too many ad's, the challenges are to short of time, only 50 points to play with, the card collection is a joke, buying stuff in the game cost to much. It cost me over 10b coins to finish and island, but you only receive maybe 25m in a good day with 50 points. I've spent probably 100 in real cash just to try to advance only to hit a wall. And they dont respond to you at all. Dont waste your time!

Fun for about 5 days and then it just gets so repetitive. It's very similar to Monopoly Go in that there's little to no strategy: you're just endlessly trying to earn chances to earn coins to complete islands, so you can earn chances to earn coins to complete more islands, aka a real snoozer. And the crazy amount of pop-ups! Like, we get it. We see all the opportunities to spend money in game. They're all on the sides in full view. If I get carpal tunnel, it'll be from clicking those ads.

Fun and addicting. I really did enjoy this game. Some things to consider: 1. The amount of pop-ups before you can play they game is ridiculous. I get you want to make money but I shouldn't have to close 15 pop-ups before playing. 2. Stop forcing us to collect items that we can't use. Like cake, fans, etc. Sure you can use what you collect for around 5 items but then you have to pay for the next item before using the rest of what you collected. 3. Make getting shields easier.

The playing time is short, and the waiting period is long(8 hours)to re-up for bolts/eergy (only 50). The pop-up ads are annoying/frequent. The price for buying an island is ridiculous, and the rewards aren't that great. You can't purchase more bolts/energy with the coins/gems you've collected. And, what's with the cards? I've only been playing this game for a couple of weeks now, and I've grown bored already.

I enjoy playing, however the game keeps getting stuck and kicking me out. When I go back in, all the energy I used during the previous session is gone, but so is the progress. So the game deletes the work I did and keeps the energy so I can't do it again. On this most recent mini game, I collected 21 of 25 gifts, well on my way to the 13k energy as the final gift. The game then kicked me out and when I went back in, it deleted all, I was back to 13 gifts. Can't reach support. It keeps happening

Whether collecting items, attacking, stealing, being forced to watch ads or play an inner game (no x as option to close it), game and ads lag/loading is ridiculous. When you're on autoplay, the timer doesn't stop regardless of any of the above. So it'd be alright if not for any of the above...like coin master concept with different animals but nothing really to write home about. Just trying to get through the levels without some kind of money-grab too is a joke. Disappointing to say the least.

You can have fun, but not too much. This game honestly only has you watch an ad "if you want too." Lately, they have had a thing where you can watch 20 minutes of ads, and get a whole bunch of stuff, regularly, and be able to play for an hour+/-. My problem is, they give you all this stuff (by watching ads), and build you up to get ready to actually win, and about 3/4th of the way thru, you can't actually win if you don't buy their offer. Charge higher bets for non pay!

Honestly one of the worst money hungry, rigged, island hopping games on the market. It's visually stunning, but you spend more time going through ads and pop-ups than you do playing the game. The game will randomly freeze and crash. And player interactions are toxic without a way to avoid single people targeting you. Once you make it to island 200, it becomes pay to play. Because there is almost no way to build up enough coins to advance without spending money.

There are way too many pop ups. And you have to spend money to advance. Also the game randomly freezes. It is. currently freezing on me right now. I can't do anything. I've forced stopped it and all. The game will not load at all. I'm over it. I did give the game 5 stars because it was fun in the beginning. It still is fun. The freezing and loading it makes, pop ups, and hard advancements makes you hate the game.

This game is definitely addictive. It is so much fun. However the glitches, freezing, and constantly closing out makes me want to give up on it. I messaged tech support ( it took days for a response.) The out come was 200 lives. I never asked for anything other than them to work on their platform. I have lost almost every single wheel spin, Sammy's jackpot, and many other perks due to glitches. They responded telling me they sent 200 lives and we're fixing it. Nothing has changed.

Honestly, it's not the worst game. There are no ads, but you will spend 5 minutes closing all the pop-ups when you first start. This game is NOTHING like advertised, and you spend half the time waiting for the energy to build up (30 minutes for only 5 energy, most of the time you use in one minute). Overall, I could use MAJOR improvement, but does test patients.

It's incredibly repetitive. You click and hold to form a bridge. It's more a game to compete with friends to see who's willing to spend more money or grind by logging in consistently and watching ads. I'm a free to play person, and I got to lvl 50 before uninstalling. The reason being the amount of pop-ups trying to sell me resources, asking for ads, or links to events was just incredibly annoying. God forbid you run out of energy to move forward, because they hit you with more pop-ups.

Getting annoyed. Gameplay is NOT as advertised. Most side quests are pay $$ to complete, and you get bombarded by up to six micro transaction requests at the start of the game and when you are out of energy. Then if you do watch an ad, 3 of 10 times it resets the game and you lose time without rewards. Not to mention that though the cost of progress increases the amount of rewards stays the same as when you started.

Honestly, there's not a lot to recommend about this game. It's a cash grab with cute animals. You'll spend half of your time closing down the dozen or so offers that pop up every time you load the game and run out of energy. They have events where you need to collect a certain number if items to get a reward but, surprise, you can collect all but one needed though gameplay and then you have to make purchase with real money to get that last one. There are much better options out there.

This game is awesome! The bridge stuff is just like stick hero which is a real classic I played growing up! The only annoying thing is the things that keep popping up like buy this or buy that or limited time offer. It sucks!!! Every single time after I use up my energy or go back in, it keeps doing it and I have to x out of every single one which is time consuming. I didn't come to this game to do that, I wanna play!! Please remove those popups they are so annoying and make the game unplayable.

So tedious, the game has a button that plays it for you. So boring, that the only reason to play is to have your Facebook PII harvested. I'm literally being paid to play, and I'm not being paid enough to put up with the constant unskippable popups, slow transitions, pointless mini games and "tournament." Games like this are an embarrassment for the poor devs that have to work on it.

when I first started this game it was Awesome! I was moving pretty fast on the levels for the first day. however, when I tried to go back to the game the next day, it stayed all the way to the last in game pop up and the app would turn black and close out. So whatever gifts or items I may have attempted to achieve, I no longer can get them.**I uninstalled and re-installed and am still not able to play this game. so disappointing 😔 really wanted to enjoy more of it.

Extremely scammy game, and they know exactly how to manipulate people into spending money. You'll be so close to getting a reward, so you think "I'll just spend a few dollars and I should get there easy" but then you end up falling just short, so you spend a few more dollars and then a few more. Maybe you get the reward that time, which makes you think that the rewards are achievable, but after level 150 it gets extremely difficult to progress, no matter how much money you spend. Waste of money.

While the game is fun, it is extremely frustrating that when the game starts, you have to make it through about 12 different in app purchases that they're trying to sell you, and then the game CONSTANTLY closes itself out, so you have to open it back up and cycle through all of the sales attempts again. Considering I started playing this game to try to earn some cash back, it makes it very difficult to complete your tasks when the game won't let you have uninterrupted play.

Enjoyable in the beginning. At first I could play with little to no purchases, but the higher the level the more coins needed to move to the next level. Like billions instead of millions. It now makes it nearly impossible to move on without paying for options. It is a shame, because I really did enjoy the game at the beginning. It also keeps freezing or stating no connection despite a strong wifi signal. If it does this while a reward is in progress the reward is lost.

This game was great at the beginning. Now it's full of pop ups, for all the events they want you to spend money on, that have to be viewed in order to play. On top of that the few areas that have decent perks that only cost an ad to watch, once clicked I'm taken to the ad, which goes to Google Play, and when you get out, the game restarts, but with no added perk. This is more frustrating than the game is worth. If it can't be fixed, I'm deleting!!

It would be fine if I didn't have to reload the game every ad break. Your ads don't load, so I have to exit the game, and reload it 50 times a game session. It's frustrating and annoying. I don't play as much as I want to because of this. Not just the ads, lagging like crazy and app constantly closes itself in the middle of playing. Frustrating as hell

^date: I love this game; kids, too, will enjoy playing. Yes, there are ads, but the ads are fast and don't interrupt during your turn; the graphics are great, fun, and enjoyable to pass the time. Free to play, items are earned or you can choose to pay for, sounds are also mutable. You can play against friends or others. I would recommend you try this out; it's a great family-friendly game.

First of, this game is not at all as advertised. Second, there is no way to earn energy besides buy it, win it or wait until it accumulates. The are too many pop ups in a row ALL THE TIME. Any time you run out of coins or energy you'll get 4-5 of them offering you to buy more, then offering to invite friends, like the game on Facebook, rate the game, etc. Too much is going on and if you don't spend money you can only play about 5 min at a time.

The premise of the game is good, there are so many "mini games" that it totally ruins the game. Also, it previews as a heavily thinking or math option basis, but it is nothing like that, basically all you are doing is a more basic option of the monopoly game, but you're helping your animal make a self stacking bridge from one point to another, over and over again.

This game could be fun but they ruined it. Everywhere you turn you get bombarded with ads to buy packages. Even when you first start up each day it takes 5 minutes to get through them, plus all the previews of mini games that you can't do yet because you haven't earned the items to play them. and if you do earn the items they're erased a few hours later if you can't stop working or otherwise living your life. It just makes the progress incredibly slow and the whole game rather annoying.

Many pay to play interruptions, but you can play without spending. The worst: 1. Many minutes to load and present multiple pay to plays. Click on an ad and come back, the game starts all over from scratch and you have to go through it all again. They also make the "x" to close the ad tiny. 2. Animations and timers work perfectly, while being laggy on the main activity of building a bridge. Sometimes press the button and seconds after release, builds bridge too short or long, losing energy.

I love this game, but recently I've started to notice it's super glitchy. I had about 2300 energy and suddenly when I was attacking someone's island it just kept loading and wouldn't move for a few minutes. I close the app and suddenly I had 426 energy. I feel like I've had other similar issues since the most recent update. I would give 5 stars if it didn't keep messing with my energy.

After a day of play, decent progress and a few purchases, the game locked up and won't respond to any input making the game unplayable. However, after linking the game to Facebook it started functioning again. While the game has fairly smooth progress at first, each island costs more coins than the previous to build, requiring more energy to get those coins. I hit a wall at 31, it would take many days or money to complete the island. Not to mention the extreme number of popups. Uninstalled.

really boring and nothing like the ad! another scam. what's the point in making an ad about how the game looks like, and then having a game that's nothing like the ad. deleting it. they have responded here about different angles but the whole game is different - on the ad you go through walls that give you more or less wood to continue the journey, here you don't gather nor choose any amount of wood - you just have it as an energy and spend it to move from island to island. boooring

this game used to be fun, but there are so many bugs happening I no longer want to play after several months of enjoying it there have been a few times I completed a mini game and not received the prize, so I have to email about it. which they do fix, though the app freezes a lot, or when you collect multiple prizes during the slide craze, the next box won't load. I have to close out of the game and restart it four or five times just to finish, which makes it frustrating and time consuming.

I wouldn't call this app a game. It's an animal walk simulator. There is nothing remotely fun during any of the interactions. There is no background while watching your character auto run over planks. Most of the features are stolen from other games that do it way better. The pop ups for ads and purchases come so frequent it makes me wonder why someone sane would waste a dollar much less time on this "game". I'm using a pay to play app and un-installed. Now I can say you couldn't pay me to play

I am very disappointed! I'm only able to play this game for one day. Once it's installed & you play it it's ok, but once you get out of the game & go back to it later it won't load. I see others have had these problems. It's seems the loading problems have not been addressed from others complaining about it everyday for over a month. This is ridiculous! Either fix the game for good or dont have it at all & please don't send me an automated message apologizing. Actions speak louder than words.

after trying for 1hr to get back on and play I am giving up on this game it consistently crashes when your trying to get through all the pop-ups they try to get you to buy. I truly do enjoy the game but it crashes way too much especially in key moments. like playing the flip coin and your two levels away and all of a sudden it crashed and you lose it all.

what is going on with it crashing??? It can even go through the massive list of things it tries to get you to buy, before the screen goes black and then closes completely. As someone else mentioned, I downloaded this game due to it being on another rewards app. I've lost the chance at so much money because I can't even get it to stay open to play it. Because some of the goals are timed, I am currently about 6 hours away from losing out on winning $89. Please fix this.

was enjoying the game until they started using ads that were 60sec long. This is crazy since, on average, you have to watch over 20 ads just at the start of the game to receive all the bonuses. I throw my phone down while these long ads are playing. I don't even look at them. 2 of the shorter apps actually encouraged me enough to download the game play hop, and I got my son a mint mobile. But why Facebook and Pinterest, etc. If you don't already have them by now, then you are not interested

Okay so the game is fun customer support is good. Down side is it takes way to long to go up levels, everything that is a seasonal quest cost money after you get so far, which I think is bs. I understand they want money but you watch ads and they get money. Not every quest should cost money to finish! I know they won't do anything about it costing money or take this review as anything more than what I don't like! I am deleting the app as all it is is a money pit.

Too many pop ups. Started playing through app that pays you to reach levels. As soon as I got near goal level, game stops working. Amazingly the pop ups to try to get you to make purchases still work. Once you get through those, you can't play the game. I don't mind ads, but this app's ads are very long. Over a minute. Skip this game.

The game itself is fun and easy to understand. When you can actually play it. On startup, you get forced pop-ups of each event every time you open the app. You can't even play the game until you close every single one. Each time you're out of energy, you're hit with multiple pop-ups trying to sell you in-app purchases. Every. Single. Time.

Easy, relaxing...can spend as much or as little real money as you like, watch ads if you want to or not.
